local function runVmDecoder()
    print("[+] Attempting to load VM wrapper script in sandbox...")
    local success, err = pcall(function()
        local chunk = loadstring(obfuscatedScript)
        if chunk then
            -- Intercept execution return values
            local res = {pcall(chunk)}
            if res[1] then
                print("[+] Script executed successfully!")
                if type(res[2]) == "function" then
                    print("[+] Returned a function closure. Dumping closure info...")
                    if getinfo then
                        local info = getinfo(res[2])
                        for k, v in pairs(info) do
                            print(string.format("    %s: %s", tostring(k), tostring(v)))
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                warn("[!] Execution runtime error: " .. tostring(res[2]))
            end
        else
            warn("[!] Failed to loadstring script: " .. tostring(err))
        end
    end)
    
    if not success then
        warn("[!] Critical error in unpacker routine: " .. tostring(err))
    end
end

runVmDecoder()
